questions.stem: A woman has 2 children named Ram and Shyam. One day, Shyam had measles with fever and rash. After 4 days, Ram developed the same symptoms. He was reported to the sub centre. Which of the following is not correct?
questions.stemHtml: A woman has 2 children named Ram and Shyam. One day, Shyam had measles with fever and rash. After 4 days, Ram developed the same symptoms. He was reported to the sub centre. Which of the following is not correct?

options.label: C
options.text: Ram got the infection from Shyam

options.label: D
options.text: If mother had reported when Shyam got the infection, Ram could have been vaccinated
